articles.summary: - Conference Call and Webcast to be Held on Wednesday, October 28, 2026 - Hope Bancorp, Inc. (“the Company”) (NASDAQ: HOPE) today announced that the Company will report financial results for its third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, before the markets open on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. A conference call to discuss financial results for the third quarter and nine months ended September 30, 2026, will be held on Wednesday, October 28, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. Pacific Time / 12:30 p.m. Eastern Time. A presentation deck to accompany the earnings call will be available on Hope Bancorp’s investor relations website located at www.ir-hopebancorp.com . articles.summary: Hope Bancorp, Inc. (the “Company”) (NASDAQ: HOPE) today announced that its Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.14 per common share. The dividend is payable on or about November 20, 2026, to all stockholders of record as of the close of business on November 7, 2026. About Hope Bancorp, Inc. Hope Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: HOPE) is the holding company for Bank of Hope, a leading regional bank serving multicultural customers across the continental United States and Hawaii, with $19.19 billion in total assets as of September 30, 2026. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Bank of Hope offers a comprehensive range of commercial, corporate, and consumer banking products and services, including commercial and commercial real estate lending, SBA lending, residential mortgage and consumer lending, treasury management, foreign exchange solutions, interest rate derivatives, and international trade finance. articles.summary: Hope Bancorp, Inc. (NASDAQ: HOPE) today announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary, Bank of Hope (“the Bank”), has completed its previously announced acquisition of the Commercial Banking Unit of SMBC MANUBANK (“MANUBANK”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of SMBC Americas Holdings, Inc. and Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation (“SMBC”). The acquisition adds an established commercial banking franchise and seasoned professionals to Bank of Hope, diversifying its deposit segments and expanding its footprint and client base in the Greater Los Angeles market.
